subject.title: Subagent sessions persist after completion, main session becomes unresponsive

question: Should completed mode="run" subagent sessions default to retained visible history, hidden/archived history, or deletion after final delivery according to `archiveAfterMinutes`?
rationale: Current source keeps one-shot subagent rows by default while docs describe completed subagent state as auto-archived; each direction changes user-visible history, attachments, task reconciliation, Control UI status, and recovery behavior.

options.title: Retain but hide/archive by default
options.body: Keep completed one-shot history inspectable while excluding terminal child rows from active/default session and status views after final delivery settles.

options.title: Delete after delivery or TTL
options.body: Make run-mode subagent cleanup remove child session rows according to `archiveAfterMinutes`, accepting less default transcript and attachment retention.

options.title: Keep visible retention
options.body: Document `cleanup: "keep"` as preserving completed rows and limit code changes to status honesty, maintenance, and clearer filtering.

recommendation.title: Retain but hide/archive by default
recommendation.body: Keep completed one-shot history inspectable while excluding terminal child rows from active/default session and status views after final delivery settles.

likelyOwner.reason: PR 50101 introduced the strongest feature-history signal for retained subagent sessions and the related dashboard/session API behavior.
